sampling_rule: Seven fixed topic categories, hash-selected first32 articles; three hash-selected original Han fragments 6..24 scalars/article before mapping. No replacement after unmappable or quarantine.
split_rule: Article pageid families unioned by sampled-fragment canonical equality or >=8scalar Jaccard3-shingle>=.8; stable minimal component pageid SHA first64bits mod100 <50 dev else heldout. train empty, this source never used for training or parameter choice.
notes: Article source dates may predate recent category timestamps; dates are separately preserved, no assumption of all2025/2026 content.
News text covers public affairs/health/technology/culture/economy but is not an independent human IME intent corpus or balanced daily chat/work corpus.
No simplified/traditional conversion; punctuation/non-Han split fragments, so some semantic context and mixed input are absent.
Quoted/contact-shaped paragraphs and flagged source exceptions are excluded before fragment selection; no claim that all third-party rights/personality rights have been exhaustively reviewed.
Near overlap is exact3-shingle Jaccard>=.8 for >=8scalar fragments; it does not prove semantic paraphrase separation.
All human input intent, accepted outputs, notes and pronunciation confirmation remain null.
